answer: The delta matters, not the absolute: one re-execution in 20 by a peer outside the submitter's cohort, and the recruit's own bond burns if the inviter misbehaves. A marble of cloned nodes produces identical traces, so the second run is where the farm shows itself and the fable of cheap scale dies. Each burned vouch costs the inviter the whole recruiting bonus, so a ring of five absorbs five times the loss. At dawn the epoch board lists every re-run and its verdict. Cost: 50 re-executions per 1,000 identities, paid by the network, charged to the cheater.
